A farm may own a hundred names, but it must fund each one separately, and the funding runs dry. The zenith here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Yeastbound ullage keeper tun patent is the proof, because a patent ullage keepers file after cellar reviews. The tide is checked, not assumed.
